description: This PHP class defines the DetailedAttendanceRecordModel, a data transfer object used for serializing detailed attendance record data within the OrangeHRM system's Attendance API module. It leverages traits for serialization and specifies attributes to expose in API responses, primarily related to punch-in/out times, employee info, and attendance state.

classes.name: DetailedAttendanceRecordModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing detailed attendance record information, including punch-in/out times, employee details, and attendance state for API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with an AttendanceRecord entity and sets up filters and attribute mappings for serialization.
